## W03
### Middle Ages

During week 3 we learned about the Byzantine Empire and the Middle Ages. I chose to design a typical male outfit, for the late 1300s, and then a noble woman's outfit (in the 15th century).

{{< pdf apd325/glossary-middle-ages.pdf width=600 height=600 >}}

## W04
### Renaissance

During week 3 we learned about the Italian and the Northern Renaissance, as well as Tudor England. I chose to design an Upper-class men's outfit, and then a simpler, working woman's outfit, both of which are from the mid-to-late 16th century

{{< pdf apd325/glossary-tudor.pdf width=600 height=600 >}}
